newsitem.title: USA: United raises some fares three percent.
newsitem.headline: United raises some fares three percent.

text.p: United Airlines raised leisure fares by three percent on Friday, but other airlines did not match the increase.
United, a unit of UAL Corp, said it had filed for a three percent increase on its advanced-purchase fares.
As of Friday afternoon, US Airways Group Inc, Northwest Airlines Corp and Delta Air Lines Inc said they did not match the fare increase.
"We've not taken any action at this time," a Delta spokeswoman said.
United spokesman Joe Hopkins said if other airlines do not match the fare increase "we'll have to make a decision at that time."
Last week, United attempted to raise domestic leisure fares. That fare hike, however, was rescinded after Northwest and US Airways did not match the increase, Hopkins said.
